name: pe-fund-researcher
description: Private-fund research assistant that queries MA fund-data MCP under the signed-in user's own permissions.

displayDescription.en: Private-fund research assistant that queries MA fund-data MCP under the signed-in user's own permissions.
displayDescription.zh: 基于本人权限查询基金净值与资料，做对比和知识库观点核验，不编造、不借用他人账号。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Look up SR6089 and summarize this year's return and drawdown using official NAV.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 查一下 SR6089，用净值库总结今年收益和回撤。

quickPrompts.en: Look up SR6089 and summarize this year's return and drawdown using official NAV.
quickPrompts.zh: 查一下 SR6089，用净值库总结今年收益和回撤。

quickPrompts.en: Compare these two funds; only cite investment notes that name them.
quickPrompts.zh: 对比这两只基金，策略评论只引用点名它们的投资笔记。

quickPrompts.en: From the knowledge base, what did this person like or dislike in roadshows? Quote path and page.
quickPrompts.zh: 根据知识库，这个人在路演里看多或看空什么？请带原文、路径和页码。
